text:
mel: quick convo 1 1 designing validation for the bulk workspace editor. two main approaches: inline errors under each field (compact, contextual) vs. a persistent top error bar that summarizes and anchors to problems. also debating required signaling: asterisk-only, explicit "Required" badge, or visually-hidden marker for screen readers. would like accessibility-first approach and decent mobile behavior.

jess: inline errors win for immediate fixability. top bar useful when there are >3 errors or server-side rejections. if we keep a top bar, make it sticky so users don't miss it on long forms.

arjun: a11y checklist: when submit fails, move focus to the first invalid field and announce the total errors via aria-live. inline messages should have aria-describedby on the input. top-bar should be keyboard-focusable and include links (or buttons) to jump to each error.

li: required indicator: 🤔 asterisk alone is terse but unclear to some. suggestion: include a short legend above the form: "* indicates required" and add `aria-hidden` asterisk with a visually-hidden `span` saying "required" for screen readers. avoids repeating the word on every label.

dana: mobile/touch nuance: top error bar must be tappable and expand to a scrollable list; avoid tiny anchors. also prefer larger hit targets for error links. on small screens, inline inline under fields fits naturally.

mel: destructive confirmation patterns for bulk actions: options: 1) typed-confirm (type exact workspace name), 2) checkbox + CTA, 3) modal with undo toast. thoughts?

jess: typed-confirm for high-risk org-level deletes only. for multi-select bulk deletes where users delete many smaller items, checkbox + clear copy + undo toast seems friendlier. typed-confirm is heavy on mobile.

arjun: telemetry idea: capture pattern used, time-to-fix, number of focus jumps, and retry counts. will help us pick defaults per context.

li: microcopy proposal for destructive modal (compact):
```
Title: Permanently delete workspace
Body: This will permanently remove all pipelines, logs, and settings for "acme-prod".
Hint: This cannot be undone. To confirm, type: acme-prod
Primary CTA: Delete workspace
Secondary: Cancel
```

dana: UX nit: keep CTAs verb-first (Delete workspace) and follow color/accessibility contrast for destructive red. include a neutral cancel link, not a button.

mel: quick poll suggestion for next Tuesday design review: present two prototypes (A: inline-first with brief summary; B: top-bar-first with jump links) and a destructive-flow matrix (typed-confirm vs checkbox+undo). recruit 6 reviewers including one keyboard-only/a11y tester.

arjun: small technical note: when jumping from top-bar to field, use `element.focus({preventScroll:false})` and ensure the screenreader reads the field label + error. add a small 200ms delay before announcing additional context if needed.

eng-ci-bot: mockups uploaded: https://rdw-internal/mockups/1778881230/validation-delete-patterns.png and test build: https://ci.rdwinf/1778881230/build

mel: thanks all 1 will add checklist and follow up with a quick usability session sign-up.
